messages.subject: Issues with dynamic indexing
parts:
Hi all,
I am getting this error message when defining my model:

Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code=replicated_scr_model, data=nim.data, constants=constants, calculate=F, check=F, inits=inits)

defining model...

Error in getSymbolicParentNodesRecurse(code, constNames, indexNames, nimbleFunctionNames,  :

 getSymbolicParentNodesRecurse: dynamic indexing of constants is not allowed in trap.locs[1:50, 1:2, group.mem[i]]. Try adding the dynamically-indexed constant as data instead (using the data argument of nimbleModel).

 Below is the section of code that I think is creating the problem. 

for(i in 1:nind){

for(k in 1:last.cap[i]){

 cp[i,k,1:(n.traps+1)] <- GetMnlDetProb(cent=cent[i,1:2], bgroup.p=bgroup.p[1:n.groups], group.mem=group.mem[i], bcap.p=bcap.p, reencounter=reencounter[i,k], b.dist=b.dist[1:n.groups],  traps.avail = traps.avail[1:n.traps,k,group.mem[i]], z=z[i], n.groups=n.groups, n.traps=n.traps, trap.locs= trap.locs[1:n.traps,1:2, group.mem[i]])                                                    

Ycat[i,k] ~ dcat(cp[i,k,1:(n.traps+1)]) #NIMBLE: same as original except for the expanded indices

    } 

}   

I tried several versions to remove the dynamic indexing out of the nimble function, but with no success, and getting exactly the same message.

for(i in 1:nind){

trapavail <- traps.avail[,,group.mem[i]]                                                   

trapgrid <- trap.locs[,,group.mem[i]]

 for(k in 1:last.cap[i]){

 cp[i,k,1:(n.traps+1)] <- GetMnlDetProb(cent=cent[i,1:2], bgroup.p=bgroup.p[1:n.groups], group.mem=group.mem[i], bcap.p=bcap.p, reencounter=reencounter[i,k], b.dist=b.dist[1:n.groups],  traps.avail = trapavail[1:n.traps,k], z=z[i], n.groups=n.groups, n.traps=n.traps, trap.locs=trapgrid[1:n.traps,1:2])                                                    

Ycat[i,k] ~ dcat(cp[i,k,1:(n.traps+1)]) #NIMBLE: same as original except for the expanded indices

    } 

}   

The message is instructing to change the data structure, but I cannot figure out how to get away from having this dynamic indexing (i.e. the group.mem of individual i becomes the index for trap grid location to use).

Can anyone advised on how to restructure the code and data to avoid dynamic indexing (by the way, the manual says that dynamic indexing is possible, so not sure what's happening).

Thank you

Mathieu

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Issues with dynamic indexing
parts:
Hi Mathieu,
Thanks for the question.  I think what this is telling you is that you are giving trap.locs to nimbleModel in the constants list but it should be in the data list if you are going to use it in this way.  Does that make sense?
-Perry
